ConnectionLog.title: ConnectionLog
ConnectionLog.description: Stores a user's verified V2Ray server connection record for fast cloud-synced reconnection.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated user who owns this connection log.

countryNameFa.description: Persian country name of the connected server (e.g., آلمان).

flagEmoji.description: Country flag emoji of the connected server (e.g., 🇩🇪).

rawUri.description: V2Ray URI string (vless://, trojan://, vmess://, ss://) of the verified server.

pingMs.description: Measured tunnel handshake latency in milliseconds.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the connection log was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the connection log was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/connection_logs/{logId}.description: User-scoped subcollection storing the authenticated user's verified V2Ray connection logs.
